description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the bundled audit script at scripts/context_cleanup_audit.py. 2. Agent runs: `python3 scripts/context_cleanup_audit.py --workspace . --state-dir ~/.openclaw --out context-cleanup-audit.json` producing a valid JSON report with all 5 canonical offender classes (tool_result_dump, automation_transcript_noise, bootstrap_reinjection_bloat, ambient_specialist_surface, summary_accretion). 3. Agent reads the audit JSON and produces context-cleanup-plan.md. PROPRIETARY TRAPS: (a) The Trim Ladder — fixes must be ordered Phase 1 first (noise discipline: silence cron OK lines) before Phase 2 (slim bootstrap) before Phase 3 (reduce ambient skills) before Phase 4 (config/runtime changes) — a generic agent will likely jump to 'delete large files' which violates the lowest-risk-first principle. (b) Every proposed fix MUST contain all 4 elements: exact change + expected impact + rollback plan + verification steps — missing any one is a failure. (c) The plan must acknowledge lower confidence since no live /context json receipt is available (no promptTokens or projectContextChars present). (d) The audit-only contract must be respected — no automatic deletions or config edits proposed without rollback coverage. The evaluator checks all of these via the audit JSON schema, offender class taxonomy, plan content, and ordering.
